classes.explanation: Balance records have no independent historical source-year metadata.
The source-content hash is present; a Git revision was not supplied.
Balance recommends transactions and does not book an executed year-end portfolio.
The independent Balance adapter lacks personal annual bookings; later decisions remain unavailable.
Price conversion reverses tied tax quotes; household totals still have to agree.
Complete transactions including personal amounts must agree before cash and runway are comparable.
